command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ssh=Get-Command ssh -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('SSH_COMMAND=' + $ssh.Source); $ver=(ssh -V 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim(); Write-Output ('SSH_VERSION=' + $ver); $svc=Get-Service ssh-agent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($svc){Write-Output ('SSH_AGENT_STATUS=' + $svc.Status); Write-Output ('SSH_AGENT_STARTTYPE=' + $svc.StartType)}else{Write-Output 'SSH_AGENT_STATUS=NOT_INSTALLED'}; $sshDir=Join-Path $HOME '.ssh'; if(Test-Path $sshDir){Get-ChildItem $sshDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {if($_.PSIsContainer){Write-Output ('SSH_ITEM_DIR=' + $_.Name)}else{Write-Output ('SSH_ITEM_FILE=' + $_.Name)}}}; $cfg=Join-Path $sshDir 'config'; if(Test-Path $cfg){$null=Get-Content $cfg; Write-Output 'SSH_CONFIG_PRESENT=YES'; $current=''; foreach($line in (Get-Content $cfg)){ $t=$line.Trim(); if($t.StartsWith('Host ')){ $current=$t.Substring(5).Trim(); if($current -notlike '*[*?]*'){Write-Output ('SSH_ALIAS=' + $current)} } elseif($current -and $t.StartsWith('HostName ')){Write-Output ('SSH_HOSTNAME_FOR_ALIAS=' + $current + '|' + $t.Substring(9).Trim())} elseif($current -and $t.StartsWith('User ')){Write-Output ('SSH_USER_FOR_ALIAS=' + $current + '|' + $t.Substring(5).Trim())} elseif($current -and $t.StartsWith('IdentityFile ')){Write-Output ('SSH_IDENTITY_CONFIGURED=' + $current + '|YES')} }}else{Write-Output 'SSH_CONFIG_PRESENT=NO'}; ssh-add -l *> $null; if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){Write-Output 'SSH_AGENT_KEYS=YES'}else{Write-Output 'SSH_AGENT_KEYS=NO'}
reason: Safely inventory existing Windows SSH configuration and identify the ShopVivaliz VM alias without exposing credentials
